risks.title: Macroeconomic Risk
risks.score_rationale: Unfavorable macroeconomic conditions, geopolitical tensions, inflation, slowing growth, currency fluctuations, and rising tariffs may negatively impact customer confidence, spending, and demand for the company's products and services.

risks.title: Price Volatility and Cost Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Volatility in raw material prices, supply chain disruptions, and pricing pressures may impact profitability. The company uses dual sourcing strategies and long-term agreements to mitigate these risks.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Technological Transformation
risks.score_rationale: Cybersecurity incidents could have a significant impact on the company. Increasing investments in digital technologies and AI expose the company to additional cyber risks.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition in the company's markets may be intense. There is a risk that competitors may adopt emerging technologies such as AI faster and more successfully than ITT.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Financial difficulties of customers and suppliers may impact the company's ability to collect receivables and maintain business relationships. Unfavorable macroeconomic conditions increase this risk.

risks.title: Shortage of Skilled Labor
risks.score_rationale: A shortage of skilled labor may impact the company's ability to maintain operations, delivery quality, and innovation. ITT addresses this risk through talent programs and selective automation.

risks.title: Regulatory and Commercial Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in regulations, tariffs, and trade policies may impact operations and profitability. ITT must ensure compliance with agreements such as USMCA to maintain access to North American markets.

ai_positioning.summary: ITT mentions artificial intelligence as a key element of technological transformation affecting the manufacturing industry. The company views AI as an opportunity to improve efficiency and reliability, but also recognizes associated cybersecurity risks and the possibility that competitors may adopt the technology faster.
evidence: Technology Transformation: Accelerating advancements in automation, data analytics, and artificial intelligence continue to reshape manufacturing and industrial solutions.
We view this shift as an opportunity to further enhance efficiency, reliability, and customer value but it also exposes us to additional cyber related risks
